verdict.rationale: Numeral's quickstart tells developers to use a TEST API key from the dashboard, and its ping endpoint reports which environment a key is in. That points to a separate test environment the product provides itself. The docs never say outright that test-mode data is isolated from production, and nothing says the MCP server or agent skills work in test mode. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/test-mode data isolation from production, test-mode behavior for the MCP server and agent tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Get a TEST API key from your Numeral Dashboard
Authenticated health check endpoint that returns status, environment, timestamp, and API version.
